Tamil Nadu Officials Urge Government Intervention on RTI Delays and Construction Curbs

The Tamil Nadu Information Commission has urged the state government to intervene urgently to address delays in migrating to an online system, which is impacting timely replies to Right to Information (RTI) requests. Separately, the construction industry body CREDAI has requested the government to establish an efficient mechanism to resolve issues caused by excavation curbs that are stalling projects.
